sanskrit_verse:
पादयोरन्तरं हस्तं भवेदध्यर्धमेव च ।
शिख्यद्वयं समासज्य धटे कर्कटके दृढे ॥
transliteration: pādayor antaraṃ hastaṃ bhaved adhyardham eva ca | śikyadvayaṃ samāsajya dhaṭe karkaṭake dṛḍhe ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The interval between the feet shall be one handbreadth plus half a handbreadth; two sheaves firmly bound together shall form a solid measure in the vessel known as Karkaṭaka.
